separation: The existing standalone service profile delegates its unchanged request sequence to the same absolute-deadline helper. The new profile preserves the five PTQ1 generation requests and invalid-scale/context controls, then attempts original PQ2 only after successful service observations and both PTQ1 Jobs and listeners are reaped. Service and rollback observations are retained separately. No overall pass is emitted unless both succeed.
rollbackRequirements: Explicit --use-original-pq2 and approved adapter; no --use-repacked-ptq1; four configured native row workers.
Exact compiled original model identity and release-bound verified readiness, followed by the existing scale-1.3 fixed tree-name request with thinking disabled and a 32-token completion cap.

Natural stop, nonempty visible content with matching digest, valid reported completion-token count and request timing; clean shutdown, owned Job empty, listener released, exactly one completed operation and zero failed operations.

Post-cleanup complete original-file length and Windows CNG SHA-256 verification through EOF; verified file and ancestor guards remain alive through per-arm powerAfter, whole-workload powerAfter and the final combined receipt. The explicit final-receipt guard proof is required.
Per-owner and whole-workload power endpoints remain observations. No performance, state parity, quality or default-promotion qualification is inferred.

budgetReview.scope: All startup and HTTP work uses the original absolute case deadline minus the applicable reserves. A missing reserve or PTQ1 cleanup leaves rollback pending without starting another owner. Complete-file verification checks cancellation before bounded reads; synchronous operating-system work is explicitly not preemptible. These source bounds do not prove that all workloads fit the owner-device allowance.

findingsCorrectedBeforeApproval.finding: The proposed rollback initially called the assertive representation parser while a model owner was running; malformed or truncated wire data could skip normal owned Stop and partial evidence finalization.
findingsCorrectedBeforeApproval.correction: The rollback now uses error-preserving try_connect/try_exchange with retained progress and transport-error disposition, performs owned Stop first, then contains parser failure after cleanup. A malformed response stays pending. Admission-closed cleanup is retained but cannot satisfy the required shutdown/pass conditions. Existing unwrap wrappers preserve prior profiles' behavior.

findingsCorrectedBeforeApproval.finding: The proposed full-file verification guard initially dropped before final status/power observations and the combined receipt, despite a retained-through-receipt claim.
findingsCorrectedBeforeApproval.correction: The verified guard is returned through rollback_owner and held until after the final combined save. The verifier requires fileAndAncestorGuardsRetainedThroughFinalReceipt=true; false and null controls reject.

These tests were reviewed as source; this reviewer did not run them locally.
